story: Raju is a daily-wage worker with no bank account. For a long time, help felt out of reach and the rules seemed confusing. One day Raju heard about Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY). It meant something real: Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account (BSBDA) with NO minimum balance requirement (cash withdrawals limited to four per month). And there was more — Small Account / Chota Khata can be opened without full legal documents (valid 12 months, extendable 12 more if you show you've applied for an Officially Valid Document). Raju took one simple step to apply, and life felt a little more secure and hopeful.
simple_explanation: PMJDY is the National Mission for Financial Inclusion launched in August 2014 to provide universal banking services for every unbanked household — banking the unbanked, securing the unsecured, funding the unfunded. From 14.08.2018 the focus shifted from "every household" to "every unbanked adult". In short, it gives you: Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account (BSBDA) with NO minimum balance requirement (cash withdrawals limited to four per month).; Small Account / Chota Khata can be opened without full legal documents (valid 12 months, extendable 12 more if you show you've applied for an Officially Valid Document).; Free RuPay debit card with inbuilt accident insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakh (Rs. 1 lakh for accounts opened before 28.08.2018).
everyday_example: Think of Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) as a helping hand from the government: you do one small, simple step and you get real support back — for example, basic savings bank deposit account (bsbda) with no minimum balance requirement (cash withdrawals limited to four per month).
key_takeaway: You may be eligible if: Indian nationals.; Minors above 10 years can open an account with support of a legal guardian. This is AI-assisted guidance — always confirm on the official portal (https://www.pmjdy.gov.in) before applying.
